reviews.text: Useless. I downloaded the app, the platform was quick to charge my account $49.99 annual fee, every time I want to generate a video, either there’s no audio, or it creates useless content which is far from the description I write. Don’t waste your money on this platform and every time I try to email them for a refund the email doesn’t go through.

Horrible pay structure compared to others. Why reload after 365 days! That is horrible. You don’t get enough coins at all. Others reload once a week. I purchased a year’s worth and that’s all I get while others give more every week. I do not recommend this at all. This should reload every week for the price. I’d recommend Clone AI because for the same price it’ll reload your tokens every week. This is truly a rip off for that difference. I wish I would’ve known before purchasing.
